sources.title: Cross-Modal Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: By leveraging the ability to correlate and utilize diverse types of information, cross-modal learning enables more accurate, contextually aware, and natural interactions in AI systems. It opens up innovative applications across various domains, from autonomous driving to immersive augmented reality experiences.
